scientific_integrity: Original forward dispersion attributed to Ellingsen and Brevik (2013). Independent validation and historical priority certification have not been performed. Finite numerical tests supplement but do not replace analytical proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact linear inviscid two-dimensional finite-depth uniform-shear gravity-capillary dispersion; known density and surface-flow reference; strictly positive shear, gravity and surface tension; exact two-wavenumber two-direction phase speeds. Inverse uniqueness only for finite positive depth. Local conditioning, not finite-sample statistical guarantees. Historical priority requires external review.
title: Two-wavenumber bidirectional tomography of a finite-depth constant-shear gravity–capillary layer
